scope: Phase 6 QA proof frontend (qa-phase6-ui): the recording clips e2e/recordings/admin-and-theme.spec.ts, playwright.record.config.ts, tools/record-e2e-clips.mjs (Playwright JSON report -> recordings manifest), the e2e suite's testIgnore, and the product fix in src/features/missions/MissionEditorScreen.tsx (refetch the topic task list after a publish/unpublish or a refused status change) with its unit test

findings.title: rec-task-list-provenance claims FR-11 but never exercises the grade, topic or modality filters
Manifest entry always lists a screenshot path, even when no still was attached
Clips that don't match the title regex are silently dropped, and the tool doesn't check for expected clips
rec-source-upload never sets grade or subject; it relies on form defaults
New unit test doesn't cover the refused-publish refetch path
rec-parts-hints-translations claims FR-8 but only proves entering one hint translation; the prompt translation is seed data and part-label translations are never asserted
rec-source-upload claims grade and subject for FR-1 but never sets them; it only checks stub defaults
The refused-publish task-list refresh (catch branch) has no test: removing it keeps the suite green
Coverage summary (FRs claimed by the Phase 6 clips plus the mission editor fix)
findings.note: Summary entry (the coverage table of the review itself), no defect; the strengthened clips are in 7dbaa43.

findings.title: FR-39 clip asserts the IP deny-list, not a swappable skin
FR-11 clip covers only source, status, page and text search; grade, topic and modality filters are not asserted
FR-8 clip enters only a hint translation; the prompt translation it asserts is pre-seeded and part-label translation is absent
FR-1 clip never selects grade or subject; it asserts the form defaults
record-e2e-clips silently drops expected clips that are missing from the report
An asserted clip can be written with no video or still on disk
Re-running the recorder wipes the vision verdicts stored in the committed manifest
findings.note: By design: re-recording replaces the stills, so the old verdicts no longer describe them; documented in the tool header. The vision-verify re-run over the 11 re-recorded clips is an open item (cost cap), marked in docs/qa/vision-report.md.

findings.title: Proposal says 'No product behaviour changes' but the slice ships a product fix in MissionEditorScreen
Ticked tasks 3.1–3.3 have no artifacts: no review-findings.json, current-state not updated, qa:verify not re-run after the code change
findings.note: Tasks 3.1–3.3 are completed later in this change (review dispositions here, qa:verify and the real-stack run at the final commit, current-state) before the archive.

findings.title: Mission editor fix is correct, but the refused-status refetch path has no test
FR-58 'no in-app toggle' check uses a narrow selector heuristic
findings.note: Kept as a clip-level heuristic, now also by accessible name (7dbaa43); the exhaustive check (every control on every screen activated in light and dark) is e2e/theme.spec.ts.

findings.title: FR-39 clip does not assert the requirement (one swappable skin)
FR-11 clip covers only 3 of the 6 required filters (grade, topic and modality are never used)
FR-8 / FR-6 assertions partly check seed data, not admin input; translated part labels never asserted
FR-1 clip never chooses grade/subject and fills publisher/edition by blind Tab order
FR-4 'shown to the child' is asserted only in the admin preview; JPG never exercised
findings.note: Child-side display of task images is asserted by e2e/practice-task.spec.ts (FR-26 test: prompt, image, inputs) and the slice7 clips; JPG acceptance is covered by the upload unit tests. The clip keeps the admin preview ("exactly as the child sees it", FR-10).

findings.title: FR-58 'no in-app toggle' check uses a narrow selector
record-e2e-clips silently drops specs without results or a non-matching title; no expected clip list
Manifest entry claims video/still paths even when no attachment exists
Refused-status refetch path (catch → refreshTaskRows) is not covered by a test
FR-7 and FR-8 claims leave parts of the requirement unasserted (hint-less task, part-label translation)
findings.note: FR-7 "tasks without hints work normally" is covered by the e2e and unit tests on hint-less tasks (practice-help); part-label translation now asserted (7dbaa43).

findings.title: FR-2 and FR-4 clips skip part of the requirement ('side by side'; 'shown to the child')
Recorder can mark a clip asserted while its screenshot is missing, and silently drops clips that have no result
FR-2 'side by side with the task editor' is not asserted
